name: cines_hold_seats
title: Hold seats (approval required)
description: Reserve (apartar) the chosen seats for a showtime under the user's Cinépolis account for ~9 minutes, without paying. Requires the user's approval. Validates the seats first. Default ticket type 'Admision General'. Returns holdId, seats, ticket type and the exact total with fees, plus `purchaseApprovalRequired`. May return status 'needs_email_code' with a challengeId if Cinépolis asks for a login code: the hub collects it via secure input and calls cines_submit_code.

seats.description: ['F7','F8'] or 'F7,F8' (validated with the same rules as cines_validate_seats)

tickets.description: Party size; must equal the number of seats

ticketType.description: Only if the user asked for a specific type (e.g. 'Que Oferton 2026')

name: cines_release_hold
title: Release held seats
description: Release (liberar) the currently held seats, or a specific holdId. Safe; no approval needed.

name: cines_hold_status
title: Current hold, purchase and session status
description: The active seat hold (if any) with time left, pending secure-input requests, recent purchases and the Cinépolis session state.

name: cines_purchase
title: Pay for held seats (approval required)
description: Pay for a hold. Hard cap $1,000 MXN. `expectedTotal` must equal the hold's `total` shown to the user. Never pass card data or codes here. While fewer than 3 purchases have succeeded, `userApproved: true` is required (only after the user tapped ✅). Never retried. May return status 'needs_cvv', 'needs_3ds' or 'needs_email_code' with a challengeId — the hub collects the secret via secure input and calls cines_submit_code. `dryRun: true` simulates without paying.

expectedTotal.description: MXN; must equal the hold's `total` shown to the user

method.description: Default paypal; card = card saved in the Cinépolis/DEUNA wallet

name: cines_submit_code
title: Deliver a secret the user typed (hub only)
description: HUB ONLY — must not be exposed to the language model. Delivers the user's secure-input reply (6-digit e-mail code, 3DS/OTP code or CVV) for a challengeId from a needs_* result, and continues the paused operation, returning its next result (held / paid / another needs_* / error). The value is never logged or returned.
